notes: WEEKLY CHALLENGES: THE PLUG'S LIST. Six jobs from your plug every week (new list each Monday) - kills, headshots, wins, bagging stash bags, taking grow spots, zombie rounds and more. Each pays XP and DZ; do all six for a free PRESTIGE chance box. Find it under WEEKLY.

PRESTIGE: at level 100 press PRESTIGE to go back to level 1 and keep everything you own. Ten prestiges, SEEDLING to KUSH KING: each gives a prestige emblem on your card, a calling card, 2,000 DZ and a free PRESTIGE box. Prestige 3, 6 and 10 add new finishes: GREENHOUSE CHROME, AMBER RESIN and FROSTED TRICHOME.

NEW: THE STASH YARD - a firing range and tutorial on the main menu. Targets from 8 to 40 m (some strafe), a checklist of the basics with your keys, live accuracy, and a free DEALER DRONE to try. Change guns from the pause menu. 500 DZ the first time you finish it; nothing there counts for XP or stats.
